author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Greetings avicus staff members. I am YouCantCMe aka Zac. I received permission from the sr staff to post another appeal. I was told by multiple staff members that racism was allowed in 18+. Racism had also just been removed from the list of things that are not allowed in 18+. I believe that these two things make this infraction false. Since racism cannot be considered bullying, spamming or trolling. While it resembles no resemblance to trolling or spamming, some people claim it resembles bullying. This is a false statement since bullying is actually use superior strength or influence to intimidate (someone), typically to force him or her to do what one wants. I tried explaining to ParaSpider why this infraction was false ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=agdDhowWP2g ). Para refused to hear me out. He instead decided to ban me and remove me as a skype contact. This ban was unjustified and false. I hope that now it will be corrected and I will be allowed to rejoin the avicus TS community. I have been told by many staff members that they don't understand why I was banned, this list includes: Jozz, Mango Poseidon, PokerFace and GrapeSmoothie (I also heard Pelpelajax believes I should be appealed). Thanks for your time. <3

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
I am sorry for the delay. There has been much discussion on your appeal. We have come to the consensus that you did, in fact, break a rule. One of the many rules that are clearly stated on our website. Almost all of the people you stated have been against the appeal because of one simple fact: Racism is not allowed on our server. Continuing to resent the rules does not show us that your behavior will improve. Hence, we have decided to deny your appeal because of the simple fact that you refuse to take responsibility for your actions. 
Also, please do not continue to spam the appeals section of the forums, if you continue to: you may be banned from the Avicus Forums.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Administrator.
